incidents.name: NCD pair surplus skim from throwaway miners
incidents.notes: NCD's transfer logic leaves surplus NCD in the NCD/USDT pair above its reserves, which the attacker harvested with pair.skim() from a series of throwaway contracts that each register their own mineStartTime.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x9601313572eCd84B6B42DBC3e47bc54f8177558E created 2024-06-01T11:23:07Z by 0x2dfecff1a7ab1436b1695196d80d3e6b15ccc92e, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xd52f125085b70f7f52bd112500a9c334b7246984; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
